thesis: The strongest short thesis is that Planet is being valued as a software/data compounder while its growth mix is moving toward capital-intensive satellite services. GAAP operating loss persists, SBC and ATM dilution are substantial, and top customers are concentrated. These are serious risks, but current liquidity, recurring ACV and positive recent FCF prevent a hard-veto conclusion.

evidence.claim: Q2 GAAP operating loss was $13.509M despite +58% revenue growth.
H1 SBC was $33.521M and Q2 ATM issuance raised $122.4M.
Three Q2 customers represented 17%, 11% and 10% of revenue.

counterevidence: Recurring ACV 98%, NDR 109%, and RPO/backlog remain strong.
Adjusted EBITDA and FCF are positive.
falsifiers: Sustained per-share FCF weakens the short thesis; renewed cash burn strengthens it.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Net cash and positive recent cash flow rebut structural financing dependence.
Dilution is material but the strict long-duration predicate is not yet established.
NDR, recurring ACV and contract demand show customer value.
Growth and contract metrics do not show persistent shrinkage.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Concentration is material but not fatal and revenue sources are diversified.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Liquidity and recent FCF substantially reduce this risk.
